hypothesis: One-bar EMA20 pullback and confirmed resumption can produce positive development net PnL after costs; exploratory hypothesis informed by already seen development losses, not independent confirmation.

entry_rules.common: i>=1001; flat; indicators ready on i and i-1; T0 production direction at i matches proposed side; confirmed bars only. Exactly previous bar, no lookback search or persistent setup state.
entry_rules.long: low[i-1]<=EMA20[i-1] AND close[i-1]<=EMA20[i-1] AND close[i]>EMA20[i] AND close[i]>high[i-1]
entry_rules.short: high[i-1]>=EMA20[i-1] AND close[i-1]>=EMA20[i-1] AND close[i]<EMA20[i] AND close[i]<low[i-1]
entry_rules.numeric_semantics: Production Decimal context; strict/non-strict comparisons as written; all EMA values computed using bars no later than their index.

exit_rules: Preserve T0 ATR from entry signal bar, initial stop 2ATR, target2R, BE trigger1R, time stop48 bars and opposite T0 production direction (not opposite PB0 entry). Confirmed-bar predicates, first eligible subsequent open. No forced terminal close; missing next bar fails closed.
comparison: Frozen T0/T1 results descriptive only; no rerun, no fresh independent comparator, no parameter ranking.

gate_semantics.drawdown: maximum marked-equity peak-to-trough loss / initial capital
gate_semantics.profit_factor: sum positive completed-trade net / abs sum negative completed-trade net; undefined fails
gate_semantics.activity: base total>=80 and each side>=30; stress SHORT>=30; insufficient count INCONCLUSIVE without lowering thresholds
gate_semantics.quarters: four UTC development quarters, include flat warmup, marked-equity returns on beginning-quarter equity

dataset.limitation: Development-only 8760 complete hourly bars; no volume; declared permission/local-only retention; derived historical finality and close-time availability; funding unavailable.
dataset.subset_verification: byte-identical to previously locked development subset; original source SHA identical

engine_readiness: UNSUPPORTED_CURRENT_MODEL: existing multi-signal entry is immediate direction; PB0 requires separately reviewed versioned strategy/engine support, targeted tests and exact authorization. No monkeypatch or new signal hidden under old engine refs.
stop_rule: Preserve all results/failures; no threshold changes or replacement variants after seeing PB0 results. Integrity/accounting failure stops campaign; terminal missing-next-bar preserves failed attempt. Mechanical reruns only exact settings with documented reason.
next_step: Implement isolated, versioned PB0 entry support with synthetic timing/state/accounting tests, retaining frozen T0/T1/SOL behavior; then obtain exact experiment authorizations before three runs.
